tei:div.tei:p: (da)༄༅// lha sman bkra shis tshe ring ma'i phrin las la brten nas tshe g.yang sgrub pa'i cho ga bkra shis gter mdzod ces bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dang dpal bzhad pa rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// 'char kha'i mdangs kyis srid zhi'i phun tshogs kun// sdud cing 'gro la stsol mdzad 'chi med mgon// grub pa'i rig 'dzin dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i gzugs// gangs can gtsug gi nor bur gyur la 'dud// skye ba gcig gi gom stabs lam lnga dang*// sa bcu'i mthar bgrod zung 'jug phyag rgya'i skur// ras dkar bla gos g.yo bas srid gsum gyi// mos gus sdud pa'i dpa' bor phyag 'tshal lo// thabs mchog bde ba'i grub ster 'dod pa mo// lhan skyes mdzes ma ye shes lang tsho can// bkra shis 'bum gyi char 'bebs rigs lnga pos// dge legs rin chen char du bsnyil bar mdzod// rnam gzhag grub pa'i gzhung las byung*// dgos pa snyigs ma'i dus su che// lag len gsal byed bdud rtsi'i 'od// lhag bsam 'o ma'i mtsho las phyung*// de'ang rje btsun ras pa chen po'i bka' brgyud rin po che rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i chos skyong ba'i rgyal mo chen mo 'di sgrub pa po'i blo khyad kyis ma dang sring mo dang grogs mo dang bran gyi tshul gyis gtso bor bsten pa'i cho ga dang 'brel par/ mchog dang tshe dang thun mong gi las sgrub pa gsum ston pa las/ sgrub pa po mchog dman kun dang mthun cing dge ba ma ltar du bsten cing*/ thun mong phrin las kyi nang tshan phywa tshe g.yang gi sgrub thabs 'chad pa la don gsum/ sbyor ba g.yang rdzas bsags pa/ dngos gzhi g.yang chog bya ba/ rjes g.yang gta' bsdam pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ rgyas pa dang*/ bsdus pa'o// dang po ni/ rang don dang 'byor ldan lta bur rgyun du 'khor ba'i rten btsugs pa dang lhan cig bsham rgyas par spro na/ gnas gtsang zhing yid du 'ong ba byi dor byas shing rgyan gyis bstar/

dus tshod nyi ma byang bgrod dang yar gyi ngo'i res gza' phur bu dang spen pa sogs dar zhing*/ rgyal dang bre phul la sogs pa phywa g.yang gi las la dge ba/ tshes gnyan gnod pa'i rgyu ba med pa'i dus su rdzas bsags pa dang*/ bya ba'i dbu zhabs khel bar byas te/ dam tshig gi bris sku bkram pa'i mdun du stegs bu rim pa gnyis pa'i dang po'i dbus su bdag bskyed gang byed kyi 'bul gtor bkod pa las/ phyag gzhes su rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ sgrol dkar gang rung la mdzad pas de dag gi gtor 'bul/ g.yas ngos su bum pa bcud ldan tshe ril tshe chang bcas pa/ g.yon ngos su ma mgon lcam dral sogs chos skyong spyi'i spungs gtor rnams bsham/ stegs gnyis par phying dkar gtsang ma'i steng du dar dkar po dri ma med pa'i rgya mtshal lcog la mas g.yung drung du g.yas skor lnga tshoms su bris pa gding*/ de'i khar rin po che'i snod gas chag med pa'i gtsang mar/ 'bras/ gro/ nas dkar mo sogs 'bru dkar ba'i phye la dkar gsum mngar gsum rin po che dang sman sna'i phye ma bsres shing ba dkar mo'i 'o ma dang mar khus sbrus pa la rten gtor lha mo so so gnas pa'i gangs ri'i dbyibs can mthong brgyud ltar shin tu legs par bcos pa'i rtse mo'i cha la gangs/ bar g.ya' dang spang*/ gsham rnams brag ri dang rtsi shing nags tshal bzang pos brgyan pa'i rnam pa can/ rtse mor rin po che dbang gi rgyal po 'bar bas mtshan pa la so so'i sku rten gyi tsakli btsugs la/ dbus kyi g.yung drung steng gtso mo zhal mdun lta dang*/ phyogs bzhir lha mo bzhi zhal nang ltar bzhag mda' rgod sgro ma mes ma shur ba lnga la lha mo so so'i kha dog dang mthun pa'i dar chen kha gru ma nyams pa re dang*/ me long*/ gsang ba'i rten rdzas dar gyi khud du gtums pa btags la rten gtor sogs so sor 'jug pa'am/ gtor ma so so'i rgyab ngos su snod 'bru yis bkang bar btsugs kyang rung ngo*// rin po che'i za ma tog gam ga'u'i nang du gsang ba'i rten rdzas rnams dang*/

srog snying mthing shog la gser gyis bris pa'i gsham du/ bdag sgrub pa po'am sbyin bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba 'khor dang bcas pa la srid srung tshe dang*/ snang gsal pra dang*/ rma g.yang zas dang*/ bang mdzod 'bru dang*/ rkang bzhi phyugs la sogs pa'i g.yang dang dngos grub ma lus stsal bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe dang longs spyod spel/ dbang thang rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ zhes sogs bris pa dang lhan cig sgrub brgyud rin po che'i dam rdzas sel med bcas bcug la rgyas bsdams pa gtso mo'i gtor ma'i rgyab tu bzhag spros pa che bar byed na ga'u lnga la sngags dang sham bu so sor rgyas pa spel zhing*/ dbus kyi g.yas g.yon tu gser gyi rdo rje dang*/ tshe bum shing pad+ma dpal be'u g.yung drung rin po che 'bar bas kha brgyan pa/ shar gyi g.yas g.yon du dar dkar gyi ba dan dang dngul dkar gyi me long*/ lhor rin po che'i sder ma zas snas bkang ba dang ne'u le'i rkyal pa/ nub tu nor bu dang rin po che'i sgrom bu/ byang du rtsa dūrba'i chun po dang sbrul zhags rnams dngos dang gzugs brnyan ri mor bris pa sogs 'byor pas dpag ste gzhag go /ga'u lnga dang phyag mtshan gyi rten rnams ma 'grub na ga'u gcig ni nges par dgos/ gang ltar/ rten gtor lnga'i mdun so sor mchod gtor 'brang rgyas rtse la rin po ches mtshan pa lnga/ bar mtshams rnams su sman ting gsang phyi 'brang rgyas rnams grangs nges med/ srog chags sna tshogs pa'i gzugs 'gros spar du btab pas bkang ba'i/ g.yas ngos su sre mo'i blud bu kha bshus sen bshus bug ral med pa'am/ ma 'dzom na de'i gzugs kyi nang du gsang ba'i rten rdzas dang g.yang rdzas kyis bkang ba bzhag de la gsang ba'i rten rdzas ni/ rab mu tig mig med/ ma 'byor na mu tig gang rung*/ dngul gyi sor gdub bud med kyis ma reg pa/ g.yu drug dkar/ bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ sin+dhu ra rnams so// g.yon tu g.yang chang dkar yol gas med dam thod pa mtshan ldan bzang por bdud rtsi lnga dang sman sna lnga'i phye ma sbyar ba'i chang gi nying khus bkang bar mar gyi ze sgro can/

nang du mar dkar las grub pa'i bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs kyis bkra bar bsham/ rgyab tu g.yang zan dkar gsum mngar gsum dang*/ zas sna las grub pa'i 'brang rgyas kyi rnam pa rtse mo rdo rje nyi zla sprin ris kyis mtshan pa bzhag mdun tu snod gtsang mar phye mar spungs pa dang*/ bdud rtsi ril bu dang ldan pa'i sman thod/ ji ltar bde ba'i bar mtshams su gtsang sha dkar mo lag g.yas mar gyi g.yung drung gis spras pa/ gro ma/ tshod ma'i snod/ g.yang nas dkar mo snod phyur bur bkang ba g.yos skyo mar gyi ze sgro can/ zas sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i snod rnams dang*/ gzhan yang g.yang rten nor sna/ shing tog sman sna/ dar sna/ gos chen/ 'bru sna rnams shin tu 'dzom che ba dang*/ nor lha'i rten byin rlabs can sogs dang*/ bye brag bkra shis pa'i ri dgu'i sa sna rdo sna/ chu sna shin tu 'dzom che ba'i rgyun dang*/ nor can dgu yi bang mdzod kyi 'bru sna/ rgyal po'i khab dang tshong 'dus chen po'i sa/ btsan phyugs 'phan dar 'dzom pa dgu'i zhing sa/ rta drel nor lug sogs kyi spu sna/ bkra shis rtags brgyad dang*/ rin chen sna bdun sogs kyi tsakli/ me long*/ gi waṃ sogs bkra shis pa'i rdzas brgyad la sogs pa/ mdor na g.yang chags pa'i rten rnams ma tshang ba med par bsag 'byor na rten gtor lnga la dar ras dkar po'i gur dbub/ ma 'byor na gtso mo'i gtor ma la dar gdugs dkar po gzug chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga dang*/ g.yab pa'i mda' dar bdug spos sogs 'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams ma tshang ba med par 'du bya'o// gnyis pa de ltar mi 'byor ba'am/ spros pa chung bar 'dod na/ gong gtor dang gdan sogs sngar dang 'dra ba las/ g.yang rten du gtor ma gangs gzugs lnga tshom snod du bzhag pa'i rtser dar gdugs dkar po dang*/ 'dzom na sku rten btsugs pa dang*/ mda' dar spyi bsdus gcig ga'u dang ne'u le ni lugs 'di'i zab gnad yin pas ga'u gcig nges par dgos/

g.yas su ne'u le zan la bzos pa/ g.yon tu g.yab chang*/ mdun du mchod gtor dang phye mar sman thod la sogs pa ste/ de phyin chad gzhi gang mtshungs la/ ji ltar 'byor pa'i g.yang rdzas dang*/ nyer spyod la sogs pa bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ bdag bskyed/ bum bskyed/ mdun bskyed do// dang po ni/ phyag len ltar bdud rtsi byin rlabs nas brtsam/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed bzlas bsdu ldang gi bar du bya ba ste jo mo nyid kyi yi dam gyi lha yin pas phrin las skul sla ba dang*/ mchog sgrub pa'i gnad zhar la tshang ba'o// gnyis pa ni/ bdag bskyed bsdu ldang grub ma thag bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las/ bh+rūm̐ las byung ba'i bum pa mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du pad zla'i gdan la hrīḥyig yongs su gyur pa las tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis mnyam gzhag mdzad pa'i steng na tshe bum bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ rgyan rnams dang stod g.yogs smad g.yogs kyis spras pa rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ de'i thugs kar zla ba la hrīḥdamar po gnas pa'i 'od zer gyis ye shes pa spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i sogs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par gyur/ dbang lha spyan drangs dbang bskur chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan par gyur/ de'i thugs kar rin po che'i za ma tog gi nang du rang dang bsrung bya'i ming ngam gzhan don du bsgrub bya de nyid gsal bar gyur/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa shin tu rnam par nges pa'i gzi brjid kyi rgyal po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs shig tshe dang ye shes kun nas rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe sa ra ha ka ra re sha ra re hūm̐ phaṭa/

lan gsum/ de nas/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags phreng gzungs thag la brgyud de song*/ bum pa'i lha la phog pas de'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros nas sangs rgyas thams cad gyi tshe'i dngos grub dang brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i bcud thams cad bsdus te bcom ldan 'das kyi shangs bug tu zhugs nas bsgrub bya'i lus thams cad la thim pas tshe yi dngos grub thob par gyur/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī ban+ti ye swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ yang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis phyogs skyong gnod sbyin la sogs 'jig rten dregs pa can rnams kyi lag nas tshe bkug nas bum pa'i chu la thim par gyur/ oṃ aṃ gu sha sa ma ya e h+ye hi ā yur+dz+nyā na tshe bh+rūm̐/ zhes nyer gcig tsam bzla/ tshe dpag med kyi sku las babs pa'i bdud rtsis bum pa khengs shing chil chil lud pa ka pā la'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe dz+nyā na a mā ra ṇi dzī ban+ti ye swā hā/ zhes bzla/ tshe ril sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gnas pa/ mām̐ ām̐ tsam̐ a tam̐ zhes pa rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ 'bru gsum mang du bzlas pas byin gyis brlab/ 'di ni tshe sgrub pa'i gnad zhar byung du tshang ba'o// bar 'dir yi dam dang ma mgon sogs chos skyong ye shes pa'i gtor 'bul dang*/ spro na tshogs kyi mchod pa'ang bya'o// gsum pa la gnyis/ spyir mchod bstod bsnyen bzlas bya ba/ bye brag phywa g.yang gi las la sbyar ba'o// dang po ni/ mdun rten gyi rdzas rnams bsang sbyangs la lhar bskyed/ spyan drangs bzhugs su gsol/ dam la bzhag do gal che na rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya bcas gtsigs la dbab pa'i sngags lan gsum dang*/ thun sngags nyer gcig brjod/ dkyus tsam la mi dgos/ ḍā ki lnga so so'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du rim bzhin am̐ ha ri ni sa'i sa bon la rang rang gi sngags kyis bskor bar gyur/

rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis lha mo lnga'i thugs kar reg ste rgyud pa bskul bas ma ltar byams pas dgongs par mos la sngags lnga po zhal shes ltar bzla/ do gal byed skabs/ mthar sing nga sogs kyi sngags dmigs phyi sgrub ltar bya/ dkyus 'gre la mi dgos/ de nas mi la'i bstod phyag tshe dpag med dang phag mo'i bstod phyag sh+lo ka re sngon tu 'gro ba'i las gzhung gi phyag mchod phreng dang gtor 'bul/ bstod pa gser skyems gsol skong bcas rgyas par bya'o// gnyis pa phywa g.yang gi phrin las bye brag tu bskul ba ni/ skabs don gyi sgrub pa gtso bo yin te/ gtor mchod kha gso/ gser skyems gsar du bsham/ tsan+dan a ga ru gu gul dkar po sogs dri bzang po'i spos btul/ bzang shing gi spos dud gtong*/ rol mo gling bu'i sgra dang dbyangs snyan pas 'di skad gyer ro// bh+yo/ rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs ni// bal bod gnyis kyi so mtshams na// gangs dkar shel gyi cod pan can// phu chu snyan pa'i rgyun sgra can// nags la me tog sham bu can// g.ya' spang g.yu yi ska rags can// sman ljongs brag gi rwa ba can// gnas mchog de 'dra'i g.yon mgul na// dar dkar gur gyi nang shed na// rin chen sna lnga'i khri steng na// bkra shis tshe yi dbang phyug ma// drag po'i gdung bas khyod 'bod na// de ring sgrub pa'i gnas mchog 'dir// lhab lhub na bza'i rgyan dang bcas// sil snyan rol mo'i sgra dang bcas// nam mkha'i mthongs nas spyan 'dren na// 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol// hūm̐/ lha sman bkra shis tshe ring ma// khyod kyi tshe dang 'brang smos pa// yab ni lho lha de bo yin// yum ni 'brang yul sman gcig ma// ming po bdun la sring mo lnga// lnga tshigs dbus kyi gtso mo ste// khyod ni gtsang rigs lha yi sras// mtshar sdug 'od du kyi li li// zhal bzang zla ba nya ba 'dra// lha mo rnams kyang zil gyis gnon// mgrin pa gcig la glu sgra stong*// tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyang zil gyis gnon// dbu skra nyag ma re re la// gser g.yu'i lan tshar stong stong ldan// na bza' dar dkar go zu gsol// rin chen du mas sku lus brgyan// nyin gsum gangs dkar stod la bzhugs// sman mo rnams dang lhan cig rol// mtshan gsum rgya gar yul du bzhugs// rab tu 'jigs pa'i dur khrod du// mkha' 'gro rnams dang tshogs 'khor rol// bka' nyan sprul pa'i pho nya sogs// ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// 'dir byon bdag gi phrin las mdzod// hūm̐/

khyod la mchod pa 'bul ba ni// bdud rtsi sman gyi rtsi phud dang*// me tog yid 'ong mdzes pa'i tshal// spos dri phun sum tshogs pa dang*// sgron me dri mchog bshos gtsang dang*// sgra snyan gsang ba'i rnge'u chung rnams// thugs brtser dgongs shing bzhes nas kyang*// byin rlabs dngos grub stsal du gsol// sngon tshe dben gnas yongs rdzong du// dpal ldan bzhad pa rdo rje la// rang rtags srog gi snying po phul// bka' 'bangs bgyid par gtsigs la phab// chos rgyud spel bar g.yar dam bcas// de ring sman btsun rgyal mo la// ming pos gsol ba 'debs pa ni// srid srung rigs rgyud spel ba dang*// snang gsal pra yi dngos grub dang*// rma g.yang zas kyi dngos grub dang*// bang mdzod nor gyi dngos grub dang*// rkang bzhi phyugs kyi dngos grub dang*// gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba yi// dngos grub ma lus bdag la stsol// khyod la gsol ba 'debs pa ni// sbyin bdag tshe srings gzi mdangs skyed// nang gi rlung sems dbang du sdus// zag bcas lus kyi bde ba skyed// phyi yi snang ba dbang du sdus// phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod// bkra shis dpal skyed 'khor skyongs la// 'gal rkyen kun sol mthun rkyen sgrubs// bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa sogs// bcol pa'i las kyi 'bras bu de// mchis par mdzod cig thugs dam can// bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag la// bkra shis dpal skyed g.yang khug cig /'brang rgyas bran la/ snod kyi 'jig rten bas kyang rgya che zhing*// ri rab lhun po bas kyang brjid chags pa// nyi zla zung gcig las kyang 'od 'bar ba// bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur pa'i gtor ma 'di// bzhad pa rdo rje yi dam chos skyong tshogs// lha sman 'khor bcas ljags kyi pad+ma ni// rdo rje rtse gsum sbu gus dgyes par drongs// oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twā ta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

oṃ shrī mān gu ru de wa badz+ra sa ma ya sarba pañca ḍā ki nī i daṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ma sarba karma sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha hūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gyis 'bul la/ phrin las bcol ba ni/ oṃ/ nyi ma nub phyogs pha gi na// gangs dkar dgung las rtse mtho ba// mtho la gnyan no tshe ring ma// de la brten pa'i lha mo ni// gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma// 'khor du 'jig rten sman mo bzhi// gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma dang ni// lha mo mthing gi zhal bzang ma// dpal ldan cod pan mgrin bzang ma// mi g.yo glang bzang 'khor dang bcas// sku la dar dkar la'u gsol// sna tshogs dar gyi lhab lhub dang*// rin chen gser g.yu'i rgyan cha can// mthu dang rdzu 'phrul mnga' bdag mo// brtan ma bcu gnyis khyod kyi 'khor// yul lha sde brgyad khyod kyi bran// so so'i g.yar dam ji bzhin du// rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod// phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad sol// spyi dang khyad par dngos grub stsol// bcol pa'i phrin las gang dang gang*// ma sring tshul gyis bsgrub par mdzod// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa// stong khams srid pa gsum gyi bcud// mi yi g.yang dang phyugs kyi rtsi// tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan grags dang*// zas nor dbang thang longs spyod sogs// phywa dang g.yang gi dngos grub ni// steng nas char bzhin 'bebs par mdzod// 'og nas mtsho ltar 'khyil bar mdzod// bar nas sprin bzhin gtibs par mdzod// ces spyir phrin las bcol nas/ bye brag tu bskul ba ni/ mda' dar g.yab la/ kyai/ rdo rje mi 'gyur dpal gyi yum// sku mdog dkar mo gzhon tshul can// chibs su seng ge dkar mo chibs// 'khor yang dkar mo 'bum sdes bskor// de ring sprul pas stong gsum khengs// sbyin pa'i bdag po 'di la ni// mi brgyud spel zhing tshe ring ba// bkra shis dpal skyed g.yang khug mdzod// shar nas rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma// sku mdog sngon mo 'tsher bag can// chibs su rkyang bu kha dkar chibs// 'khor yang sngon mo 'bum=

/de ring sprul= /sbyin pa'i= mi brgyud= 'khor 'bangs spel ba'i g.yang khug mdzod// lho nas rdo rje bzhad pa mo// sku mdog gser sbyangs btso ma'i mdog /chibs su stag mo grus ma chibs// 'khor yang ser mo 'bum= /de ring= /sbyin pa'i= /mi brgyud= /zas nor longs spyod g.yang khug mdzod// nub nas rdo rje dpal mo che// sku mdog li khri'i zhun lta bu// chibs su sha ba yu mo chibs// 'khor yang dmar mo 'bum= /de ring= /sbyin pa'i= /mi brgyud= /rin chen bang mdzod g.yang khug mdzod// byang nas rdo rje gar mkhan ma// sku mdog ljang gu margad mdog /chibs su g.yu 'brug sngon mo chibs// 'khor yang ljang mo 'bum= /de ring= /sbyin pa'i= /mi brgyud= /nor phyugs 'phel ba'i g.yang khug mdzod// oṃ badz+ra ma ma ru ru tsit+ta dha mi badz+ra tre hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra bha ki mu ta hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ya tra sing sing hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra bhi pra ni hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pri sa ri ting ting kha ting dz+nyā na hūm̐ bh+yo dzaḥ de nas las la sbyor ba'i bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ dmigs pa'i gzhi sngar ltar las/ rang yi dam gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dkar po bde ba'i reg bya can 'phros/ gtso mo la phog pas oṃ yig mi g.yo bar sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor bas sngon gyi dam tshig dran nas sku las 'od zer dkar po phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'jig rten khams kyi tshe bsod 'byung ba'i bcud thams cad 'od zer dkar po'i rnam par bsdus nas/ bdag dang sbyin bdag g.yang rdzas rnams la sib sib thim/ tshe ring ba dang bsod nams 'phel ba rigs brgyud chos brgyud dar ba'i dngos grub thob cing de lta bu'i dngos grub stsol bar gsung yang byon par bsgoms la/ oṃ a ka ni tsa li mi thu phri li ri yi ā yuḥpuṇ+ye dz+nyā na puṣ+ṭiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ mthar/ jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma// dpal 'bar bkra shis gzi brjid che// mi 'gyur yon tan kun rdzogs ma// srid srung tshe yi phywa g.yang stsol// oṃ maṃ maṅga la ā yur dīr+gha añji dhā ra swā hā/

zhes 'dod don gsol/ des 'gres te/ 'od zer sngon pos mthing gi zhal bzang ma'i thugs rgyud bskul ba'i spro bsdus 'jig rten khams kyi dpa' bo ḍā ki drang srong grub pa lha 'dre rnams kyi mngon par shes pa dang*/ zhi ba'i las kyi dngos grub thams cad 'od sngon po'i rnam par bsdus te thim pas/ snang gsal pra dang nad gdon bar chad thams cad zhi ba'i phywa g.yang thob cing gsung byon par mos la/ oṃ na tri ma tri ru ru ma tri na me tad+ya thā/ bha gi pu ṣ+ya ma ni ston/ ba su puṇ+ye ston/ sha ri ma ni ston/ smos smros/ sarba u pa dra be shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bzlas mthar/ jo mo mthing gi zhal bzang ma// dpal 'bar bkra shis gzi brjid che// mi 'gyur yon tan kun rdzogs ma// snang gsal pra yi phywa g.yang stsol// oṃ laṃ in+d+ra nī la mu kha bha dra añji dhā ra swā hā/ de bzhin tu/ 'od zer ser pos mi g.yo glang bzang ma'i thugs rgyud bskul ba'i spro bsdus 'jig rten khams kyi rma g.yang zas dang longs spyod kyi phywa g.yang thams cad 'od ser po'i rnam par bsdus te thim pa sogs bsgoms la/ oṃ ḍā ki nī sa pa ri tsakra mu ni tiṣ+ṭha rbad lo na na kha dhe rat+na sid+dhi hūm̐ swā hā/ bzlas mthar/ jo mo mi g.yo glang bzang ma// dpal 'bar bkra shis gzi brjid che// mi 'gyur yon tan kun rdzogs ma// rma g.yang zas kyi phywa g.yang stsol// oṃ am̐ a tsa la ha sa bha dra añji dhā ra swā hā/ yang 'od zer dmar pos cod pan mgrin bzang ma'i thugs rgyud bskul ba'i spro bsdus 'jig rten khams kyi bang mdzod 'bru'i phywa g.yang thams cad 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par bsdus te thim pa sogs sgom bzhin tu/ oṃ ḍā ki nī kan+t+ra pa ni mā ra ya dzaḥdzaḥdha na brī hi sid+dhi hūm̐ swā hā/ bzlas mthar/ lha mo cod pan mgrin bzang ma// dpal 'bar bkra shis gzi brjid che// mi 'gyur yon tan kun rdzogs ma// bang mdzod nor gyi phywa g.yang stsol// oṃ tsam̐ mu ku ṭa ma dhū ra bha dra añji dhā ra swā hā/

yang 'od zer ljang gus gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma bskul ba'i spro bsdus 'jig rten khams kyi rkang bzhi phyugs kyi phywa g.yang thams cad bsdus te thim pa sogs bsgoms la/ oṃ a ni ni ma ta ra ki ni mi thu ni phri li ri ye sarba pā thu sid+dhi hūm̐ swā hā/ bzlas mthar/ jo mo gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma// dpal 'bar bkra shis gzi brjid che// mi 'gyur yon tan kun rdzogs ma// rkang bzhi 'phel ba'i phywa g.yang stsol// oṃ hi two bha wa dza gad bha dra añji dhā ra swā hā/ zhes las bcol/ mjug gi mtshan sngags rnams kyang lan bdun nam gsum re tsam bzla grub na legs so// bsnyen pa'i mjug don gser skyems dang bsangs mchod 'bul cing phrin las la bskul ba ni/ oṃ/ rdo rje mi 'gyur dpal gyi yum// sku mdog dkar mo gzhon tshul can// phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje bsnams// g.yon pas tshe yi bum pa 'dzin// bum pa'i steng na dpal be'u dang*// g.yung drung rin chen 'khyil bas brgyan// lhab lhub na bza'i rgyan dang ldan// sil snyan rol mo'i sgra dang bcas// rin chen du mas mdzes par bklubs// bkra shis tshe yi gtso mo ste// chibs su seng ge dkar mo chibs// gangs dkar stod na bzhugs pa mo// 'dir byon g.yang gi rten la bzhugs// gser skyems zas phud gtsang mas mchod// bzang shing spos kyi dud pas bsangs// snod bcud kun gyi phywa g.yang khug /srid srung tshe yi dngos grub stsol// lha mo mthing gi zhal bzang ma// rdo rje khros ma zhes su grags// sku mdog sngo bsangs 'tsher bag can// chibs su rkyang bu kha dkar chibs// phyag g.yas dngul dkar me long bsnams// g.yon pas lha yi ba dan 'phyar// sku la dar dkar na bza' gsol// sil snyan rol mo'i sgra dang bcas// 'dir byon g.yang= /gser skyems= /bzang shing= /snod bcud= /snang gsal pra yi dngos grub stsol// lha mo mi g.yo glang bzang ma// gsang mtshan rdo rje bzhad pa mo// sku mdog ser mo gser gyi mdog

/chibs su rgya stag khra bo chibs// phyag g.yas rin chen sder bzang nang*// lha yi zhal zas sna tshogs bsnams// g.yon na ne'u le'i rkyal pa 'dzin// sgrub pa po yi grogs mdzod cig /'dir byon g.yang= /gser skyems= /bzang shing= /snod bcud= /rma g.yang zas kyi dngos grub stsol// lha mo cod pan mgrin bzang ma// rdo rje dpal mo longs spyod yum// sku mdog dmar gsal mdangs dang ldan// chibs su sha ba yu mo chibs// phyag g.yas yid bzhin nor bu dang*// phyag g.yon rin chen sgrom bu bsnams// snang srid thams cad dbang sdus la// rnal 'byor bdag gi phrin las mdzod// 'dir byon= /gser skyems= /bzang shing= /snod bcud= /bang mdzod 'bru yi dngos grub stsol// lha mo gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma// gsang mtshan rdo rje gar mkhan ma// sku mdog sngo ljang mdangs dang ldan// chibs su g.yu 'brug sngon mo chibs// phyag g.yas rtswa mchog dūrba dang*// g.yon pas sbrul gyi zhags pa bsnams// phrin las thogs pa med pa yi// mthu dang nus pa 'dir ston cig /'dir byon g.yang= /gser skyems= /bzang shing= /snod bcud= /rkang bzhi phyugs kyi dngos grub stsol// g.yang 'gugs pa ni/ mda' dar g.yab la/ bso bso yā yā a ti hoḥ de ring phyā dang g.yang du blan// de ring dpal dang g.yang khug cig /zas nor longs spyod g.yang khug cig /phyogs phyogs de ni pha gi na// nyi ma steng phyogs pha gi na// sprin dkar lding ba'i 'og shed na// shel dkar gur phub nang shed na// rin chen g.yu yi khri steng na// lha sman 'bum gyi gung dbus na// rdo rje kun bzang dpal gyi yum// bkra shis tshe yi dbang phyug ma// mched lnga 'khor dang bcas pa rnams// dad dang gdung bas khyod 'bod na// nyi zer 'char ka'i mdangs la chibs// rdzu 'phrul zhabs kyis skad cig la// do nub sgrub pa'i gnas 'dir byon// gser skyems dza gad mchod pa bzhes// dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i mchod pa bzhes// 'dod yon zhal zas sna tshogs bzhes// sman raka gtor tshogs mchod pa bzhes// sarba pū dza a la la hoḥ

bso bso yā yā a ti hoḥ hūm̐/ sngon tshe bzhad pa rdo rje yis// bka' btags dam tshig dran mdzod la// brtse gdung dgongs pa ma g.yel bar// ma yis bu la pham phab zhu// sgrub rdzas rnams la nus pa zhu// rten rdzas rnams la byin rlabs zhu// gnas khang 'di la g.yang cig khug /'dzam gling byang phyogs rgyal khams kyi// tshe dpal bsod nams phywa g.yang dang*// zas nor longs spyod dngos grub zhu// mi nor dpal 'byor mnga' thang dang*// bkra shis phywa g.yang dngos grub rnams// de ring g.yang rdzas 'di la khug /gser skyems bdud rtsi'i mchod pa bzhes// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// ces brjod la gser skyems dbul/ oṃ de bī bhi sha /mahā bhi sha /añji dha ri/ mam̐ tsam̐ ām̐ lam̐ tam̐/ lhang lhang ḍā ki ma las la rub rub swā hā/ zhes nyer gcig tsam bzlas pas/ srid pa gsum gyi tshe bsod 'khor slob rigs brgyud bza' btung longs spyod rin chen bang mdzod nor phyugs mnga' thang snyan grags kyi bcud g.yang thams cad dkar la gsal zhing snum la 'dril ba'i 'od zer gyi tshul du phyogs bcu nas kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar thib thib byung nas mdun gyi tshe rten g.yang rten dang*/ bsgrub bya'i mi nor zhing khang rnams la thim pas bkrag mdangs snum 'od gzi brjid dang ldan par bsgom/ phywa g.yang gi las la sbyor ba 'di nyid sgrub pa'i dngos gzhi yin pas/ mdun bskyed mchod bstod sogs gong du tshar gcig gis 'thus/ bh+yo/ rdo rje gdan gyi sogs nas 'di yan nyin mo der tshar grangs gang 'grub bya dgos so// zhag grangs byed na dgong mo dang*/ g.yang gtad bya ba'i skabs kyi thog mar spyi ltar g.yang 'gugs dmigs bsal spro na gnyis/ spyir rigs lnga mkha' 'gros khams lnga'i bcud g.yang 'gugs pa dang*/ bye brag sman btsun mched lngas snod bcud kyi phywa g.yang sdud par bskul ba'o// dang po ni/ spros pa che bar byed na/

bu mo gtsang ma rgyan gyis brgyan pa lngas mda' dar lnga g.yab cing*/ bsang dud dang khu ye sgrogs pa sogs spyi ltar byas la/ bh+yo/ gzugs phung gti mug gnas dag chos dbyings mdangs// dus gsum rgyal yum chos dbyings dbang phyug ma'i// thugs sprul bud+dha gar dbang mkha' 'gro ma// dkar mo sna tshogs mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor// phyag na sdud byed g.yab dar dkar po bsnams// sna tshogs las mun myur sgrub bden mthu can// dar dkar g.yab cing rgyud bskul spyan 'dren no// tshe bsod dpal 'byor phywa g.yang 'gugs par mdzod// phyogs bcu nam mkha'i nus bcud tshe bsod g.yang*// steng 'og lha klu sa bdag lag nas drongs// mi phyugs gnas khang nor rdzas rten 'dir bstim// dwangs gsal gdal khyab tshe g.yang brtan par mdzod/ bh+yo/ rnam shes zhe sdang gnas dag me long mdangs// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum mchog mā ma kī /thugs sprul rdo rje gar dbang mkha' 'gro ma// sngon mo zhi ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor// phyag na 'gugs byed g.yab dar sngon po bsnams// mi mthun las rkyen gzhom pa'i bden mthu can// dar sngon g.yab cing rgyud bskul spyan 'dren no// tshe bsod dpal 'byor phywa g.yang 'gugs par mdzod// phyogs bcu'i chu khams nus bcud tshe bsod g.yang*// shar phyogs dri za rgyal 'gong lag nas drongs// mi phyugs gnas khang nor rdzas rten 'dir bstim// snum bcud dkyus ring tshe g.yang brtan par mdzod// bh+yo/ tshe rab nga rgyal gnas dag mnyam nyid mdangs// dus gsum rgyal yum sangs rgyas spyan ma yi// thugs sprul rin chen gar dbang mkha' 'gro ma// ser mo rgyas pa'i mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor// phyag na 'ching byed g.yab dar ser po bsnams// tshe bsod dpal 'byor bskyed pa'i bden mthu can// dar ser g.yab cing rgyud bskul spyan 'dren no// tshe bsod dpal 'byor phyā g.yang 'gugs par mdzod// phyogs bcu'i sa khams nus bcud tshe bsod g.yang*// lho phyogs gshin rje srin thel lag nas drongs// mi phyugs gnas khang nor rdzas rten 'dir bstim// sra brtan gzhom med tshe g.yang brtan par mdzod// bh+yo/

'du shes 'dod chags gnas dag sor rtog mdangs// dus gsum rgyal ba skyed yum gos dkar mo'i// thugs sprul pad+ma gar dbang mkha' 'gro ma// dmar mo dbang gi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor// phyag na 'gugs byed g.yab dar dmar po bsnams// snang srid dbang du 'gugs pa'i bden mthu can// dar dmar g.yab cing rgyud bskul spyan 'dren no// tshe bsod dpal 'byor phywa g.yang 'gugs par mdzod// phyogs bcu'i me khams nus bcud tshe bsod g.yang*// nub phyogs klu dbang btsan bdud lag nas drongs// mi phyugs gnas khang nor rdzas rten 'dir bstim// drod bkrag gzi 'bar tshe g.yang brten par mdzod// bh+yo/ 'du byed phrag dog gnas dag bya grub mdangs// dus gsum rgyal yum dam tshig sgrol ma yi// thugs sprul karma gar dbang mkha' 'gro ma// ljang mo las kyi mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor// phyag na myos byed g.yab dar ljang gu bsnams// bar chad dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i bden mthu can// dar ljang g.yab cing rgyud bskul spyan 'dren no// tshe bsod dpal 'byor phywa g.yang 'gugs par mdzod// phyogs bcu'i rlung khams nus bcud tshe bsod g.yang*// byang phyogs gnod sbyin ma mo'i lag nas drongs// mi phyugs gnas khang nor rdzas rten 'dir bstim// g.yo myur stobs ldan tshe g.yang brtan par mdzod// gnyis pa ni/ kye/ dbus kyi phyogs nas g.yang gi bdag mo ni// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro dung gi thor tshugs can// tshe la mnga' mdzad dkar mo 'bum gyis bskor// lha sman rgyal mo'i thugs dam gnad nas bskul// 'phags pa'i thugs rje'i byin rlabs nus rtsal dang*// lha dang drang srong gnod sbyin bsod nams las// grub pa'i mnga' thang snyan grags longs spyod dang*// 'khor los sgyur ba'i phywa g.yang 'dir khug cig /dar po'i dar g.yang btsan po'i btsan g.yang dang*// phyug po'i phyug g.yang thams cad 'dir khug cig

/shar gyi phyogs nas phywa dang g.yang 'gugs pa// bsod nams nyi zla bzhin du shar cing byon// lho yi phyogs nas phywa dang g.yang 'gugs pa// nor phyugs lho sprin bzhin du 'thib cing byon// nub kyi phyogs nas phywa dang g.yang 'gugs pa// snyan grags g.yu 'brug bzhin du sgrog cing byon// byang gi phyogs nas phywa dang g.yang 'gugs pa// longs spyod sbrang char bzhin du 'bab cing byon// mtshams bzhi'i phyogs nas phywa dang g.yang 'gugs pa// tshe dpal rgyud ring chu bo bzhin du byon// steng gi phyogs nas phywa dang g.yang 'gugs pa// yon tan kun khyab nam mkha' bzhin du byon// bar snang phyogs nas phywa dang g.yang 'gugs pa// mi brgyud skar 'tshogs bzhin du bkra zhing byon// 'og gi phyogs nas phywa dang g.yang 'gugs pa// nyams rtogs rtsi shing rgyas ltar smin cing byon// shar phyogs rgya yi ja dar 'dir sdus shig /lho phyogs rgya gar chos g.yang 'dir sdus shig /nub phyogs gu ge'i gser g.yu 'dir sdus shig /byang phyogs ge sar rtsal g.yang 'dir khug cig /cang shes rta yi rta g.yang 'dir khug cig /za le 'bri yi 'bri g.yang 'dir khug cig /tshe tshe ra yi ra g.yang 'dir khug cig /g.yang dkar lug gi lug g.yang 'dir khug cig /rtsi mchog mar gyi mar g.yang 'dir khug cig /'bras drug 'bru yi 'bru g.yang 'dir khug cig /zad med gter gyi bum pa ltar mdzod la// dpal 'byor mtsho ltar rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// kye/ shar gyi phyogs nas g.yang gi bdag mo ni// rdo rje mkha' 'gro mthing gi thor tshugs can// shes rab mnga' mdzad sngon mo 'bum gyis bskor// mthing gi zhal bzang thugs dam gnad nas bskul// 'phags pa'i thugs rje sogs gong ltar 'gres so/ kye// lho yi phyogs nas g.yang gi bdag mo ni// rin chen mkha' 'gro gser gyi thor tshugs can// zas nor mnga' mdzad ser mo 'bum gyis bskor// mi g.yo glang bzang thugs dam gnad nas bskul// 'phags pa'i thugs rje sogs/

kye/ nub kyi phyogs nas g.yang gi bdag mo ni// pad+ma mkha' 'gro bye ru'i thor tshugs can// 'bru bcud mnga' mdzad dmar mo 'bum gyis bskor// cod pan mgrin bzang thugs dam gnas nas bskul// 'phags pa'i thugs rje sogs/ kye/ byang gi phyogs nas g.yang gi bdag mo ni// las kyi mkha' 'gro g.yu yi thor tshugs can// nor phyugs mnga' mdzad ljang mo 'bum gyis bskor// gtad dkar 'gro bzang thugs dam gnad nas bskul// 'phags pa'i thugs rje sogs brjod la/ mthar grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i gsung byin rlabs can gyi khu ye ni/ kye/ stong gsum khams na yul bde zhing*// rdzong btsan khrims snyan dus char bab// lo legs chos dar phyi yi g.yang*// deng 'dir khu ye phywa g.yang len// mi chos phyugs brgyud 'phel nang gshin// pho dpa' mo mdzangs 'og rta mgyogs// go btsan mtshon rno nang gi g.yang*// deng 'dir= /mkhas grub rtsod rgyal don gnyis 'grub// nad med tshe ring rgyags skyid bde// mthar thug 'tshang rgya don gyi g.yang*// deng 'dir= /chos dbyings chos can bslu med mthu// bden pa'i tshig la dbang rnams kyis// ci btab smon lam 'grub pa'i g.yang*// deng 'dir= /tshogs rdzogs rten 'brel mnga' thang las// rdzas rtags rgyal srid nye bcas kyis// 'jig rten dge mdzad bkra shis g.yang*// deng 'dir khu ye phywa g.yang len// dza ya dza ya sid+dhi hoḥ zhes brjod/ nyin grangs skabs 'di mtshams rjes kyi bya ba mchod bstod phrin bcol nongs bshags brtan bzhugs bkra shis sogs byas pas 'grub bo// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la g.yang gta' bsdam pa ni/ gser skyems dang bcas pa'i g.yang 'gugs sngags bzlas yan grub pa dang*/ sbyin bdag rnams gos gsar pa gyon te/ stan dkar 'bru gtsang gis g.yung drung bris pa la bzhag mda' dar g.yab la g.yang 'gugs rgyas pa gong ltar gyer/ de nas dbus kyi rten rnams lag tu gtad la/

kye/ jo mo bkra shis tshe ring ma// dpal 'bar bkra shis gzi brjid che// mi 'gyur yon tan kun rdzogs ma// de ring rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag la// srid srung tshe yi phywa g.yang stsol// oṃ maṅga la ā yuḥdīr+gha añji dha ra swā hā/ sarba sid+dhi pha la de hi hoḥ des rigs 'gres shar lho nub byang gi rten rnams rim par gtad la/ gong du bsnyen pa'i skabs su smos pa de nyid la tshig dang sngags sham cung zad bsgyur bas re re bzhin sprad la/ rten rnams re zhig rang mal du slar bzhugs/ sbyin bdag nang ma dam ldan gal chen yin na srog gtad skabs ltar de ltar byin pas zhal bzhes rjes su 'brang bar mos la/ bzhad pa rdo rje'i spyan snga sogs brjod la tha tshig 'bog go /gong ltar mtha' rten tu/ sangs rgyas bstan srung sogs kyis phrin las bcol/ tshe gzungs brjod la tshe rdzas sbyin/ bkra shis pa'i phye mar sngon 'gro'i tshe zan/ g.yang chang*/ g.yang zas/ gro ma/ dbu kyu/ zas sna tshogs kyi snod/ g.yang nas sogs lag tu rim par gtad/ de dag gis kyang g.yang mar byugs/ g.yang zas za/ g.yang chang btung*/ g.yang thod gdags par bya/ de dag gi tshe zhal nas gsungs pa'i tshigs su bcad pas thog drangs te bkra shis rgyas par brjod la sbyin bdag gnas su btang*/ slar mchod pa kha gsos la rjes chog byin rlabs sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod bstod rgyas par bya/ nongs bshags bzod gsol grub mtshams rten rnams gang du bzhag 'os pa'i sar bkod legs mchod pa'i bye brag bcas bzhugs su gsol la/ oṃ/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes ngang nyid las// thabs mkhas thugs rjes lha mo'i tshul bzung nas// sangs rgyas bstan pa srung zhing spel mdzad ma// mkha' 'gro chen mo bkra shis tshe ring ma// dpon g.yog lngar bcas zhing skyong mkha' 'gro ma'i// 'khor gyi tshogs dang bcas pa 'dir gshegs la// g.yang rten rnams la mi 'bral rtag par bzhugs// dngos 'byor yid sprul mchod pa'i bye brag dang*// dza gad sman phud mchod pa 'di bzhes la// sngar bcol las rnams grub pa'i gtang rag dang*// da bcol bsgrub phyir gtor ma sman phud bzhes// rnal 'byor bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po la// tshe dang dpal 'byor bsam pa'i don rnams la// bar du gcod byed nad dang gdon bgegs dang*// mi dang 'byung po'i bar chad bzlog tu gsol// deng nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob bar// sa dang lam gyi yon tan bsgrub pa la// bar du gcod byed 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang*// mthun rkyen 'dod dgu ma lus 'grub par mdzod// bstan dang bstan pa'i khur 'dzin skyes bu dang*// rnal 'byor 'gro don phyogs bcur 'phel ba dang*// gang la gang 'dul phrin las rnam pa bzhi// 'gro la phan bde 'grub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod// ces phrin las bcol la/

gta' bsdam pa ni/ hūm̐/ dbus nas sku yi ḍā ki nī// dkar mo sangs rgyas rigs kyi yum// pad can bkra shis tshe ring ma// dkar mo 'bum sde'i 'khor dang bcas// mchog thun dngos stsol khyad par du// srid srung tshe g.yang 'gugs par mdzod// rgyal mtshan lta bur mi nub pa'i// tshe g.yang bde drod dbang thang gzi// rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stsol// sku yi rdo rje brtan par mdzod// tshe g.yang bcol lo gta' bsdams la// sku yi 'khor los rgyas thob cig /oṃ sarba bud+dha ḍā ki nī kā ya tsakra mu dra su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ hūm̐/ shar nas thugs kyi ḍā ki nī// sngon mo rdo rje rigs kyi yum// ri mo mthing gi zhal bzang ma// sngon mo 'bum sde 'khor dang bcas// mchog thun dngos stsol khyad par du// snang gsal pra g.yang 'gugs par mdzod// g.yung drung lta bu mi 'gyur ba'i// tshe g.yang mkhyen brtse nyams rtogs rtsal// rnal 'byor bdag gi yid la stsol// thugs kyi rdo rje'i dbang thob mdzod// tshe g.yang bcol lo gta' bsdams la// thugs kyi rdo rjes rgyas thob cig /oṃ sarba badz+ra ḍā ki nī tsit+ta badz+ra mu dra su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ hūm̐/ lho nas yon tan ḍā ki nī// ser mo rin chen rigs kyi yum// ba lang mi g.yo glang bzang ma// ser mo 'bum sde 'khor dang bcas// mchog thun dngos stsol khyad par du// bza' btung gos rgyan g.yang 'gugs mdzod// nyi zla ltar gsal cha rdzogs pa'i// tshe g.yang mthu stobs 'dod 'byor byin// rnal 'byor bdag gi nus par stsol// ye shes rdo rje bltams par mdzod// tshe g.yang bcol lo gta' bsdams la// yon tan nor bus rgyas thob cig /oṃ sarba rat+na ḍā ki nī gu ṇa ma ṇi mu dra su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ hūm̐/ nub nas gsung gi ḍā ki nī// dmar mo pad+ma rigs kyi yum// dung can cod pan mgrin bzang ma// dmar mo 'bum sde 'khor dang bcas// mchog thun dngos stsol khyad par du// rin chen bang mdzod g.yang khug mdzod// rdo rje lta bur gzhom med pa'i// tshe g.yang snyan grags bden grub nus// rnal 'byor bdag gi ngag la stsol// gsung gi rdo rje 'grub par mdzod// tshe g.yang bcol lo gta' bsdams la// gsung gi pad+mas rgyas thob cig

/oṃ sarba pad+ma ḍā ki nī wā ka ka ma la mu dra su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ hūm̐/ byang nas phrin las ḍā ki nī// ljang mo karma rigs kyi yum// ri dwags gtad dkar 'gro bzang ma// ljang mo 'bum sde 'khor dang bcas// mchog thun dngos stsol khyad par du// rkang bzhi phyugs g.yang 'gugs par mdzod// yid bzhin nor ltar bsam 'phel ba'i// tshe g.yang 'khor slob bstan 'gro'i don// rnal 'byor bdag gi lus la stsol// ngo bo rdo rje mthar phyin mdzod// tshe g.yang bcol lo gta' bsdams la// phrin las rgya gram rgyas thob cig /oṃ sarba karma ḍā ki nī kar+ya bi shwa badz+ra mu dra su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ hūm̐/ lha sman mched lnga nyid dang der// skyo bsang bsnyen bkur shul 'brang ba// snag gnyen mngag gzhug ru 'dren tshogs// lha klu dri za mi'am ci// gnod sbyin rmugs 'dzin rig pa 'dzin// grub pa lha min bu mo'i tshogs// brtan ma phyogs skyong sde brgyad gzhan// ming du 'tshal zhing srid do cog /kun kyang khyo shug rigs cho 'brang*// rang rang dbang bsod tshe las g.yang*// zla nyi ri gling 'byung lnga'i bcud// gzhan yang sngon lan chags dang 'phral// rkyen ldang ma rungs gdug pa'i sdes// tshogs gnyis bsgrub la bar bcad nas// brkus 'phrog yar nyams sbas pa'i skung*// mdor na 'khor 'das snod bcud kyi// nus byin tshe bsod dpal g.yang kun// rten 'dir khug bstim gong du spel// gta' sdom rgyas thob brtan par spos// srung skyob mel tshes rtag tu skyongs// oṃ sarba dharma pā la rak+ṣi ta rak+ṣan+tu sha ra ṇa gup+ta mu dra su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod cing sgo bsdams la rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyi rgyas gdab/ man ngag ltar me tog 'thor/ rten snying brjod la brtan bzhugs dang shis brjod rgyas par bya'o// sgrub pa thon nas rab zhag nyer gcig 'bring bcu/

mthar zhag bdun gyi ring*/ dkon mchog mchod pa'i las ma gtogs nor 'bru sogs phyir gtong ba 'dzem mo// de nas kyang g.yang sgrub kyi rten rdzas rnams la dus bzang rnams su bsangs dang gser skyems mchod pa'i bye brag ci 'byor pas mchod cing lo dus su sgrub pa bskyar ma byas pa'i phan yon ni/ gtsang smyon rus pa'i rgyan can gyi zhal nas/ de ltar bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bu sgrub pa po tshe ring ba dang*/ nad med pa dang*/ grub chen brgyad la sogs pa thob nas longs spyod pas mi brel ba dang*/ sgrub brgyud chu bo'i gzhung ltar ring ba dang*/ mthar phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub mkha' la spyod pa'i go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs shing*/ khyad par tshe dang nor dang dbang phyug gi 'dod pa zad mi shes pa 'jo ba rtsa ba'i gzhung las rgya cher gsungs pa dang*/ lha mo 'di nyid bsten cing mchod pa tsam gyis bkra shis shing don thams cad 'grub pa sgrub brgyud rin po che rnams kyis yang yang du gsungs shing bsngags so// bstan pa'i dbu 'phang dam chos sgrub pas bstod// chos sgrub pa la chos mthun 'tsho rkyen dgos// kha na ma tho med pa'i dpal gyi g.yang*// sdud byed sgrub thabs 'di min gzhan mchog gang*// snod bcud dpal 'byor dpag bsam 'khri shing ni// re ba'i sum rtsen grong du rgyas pa las// dge legs 'dzad du med par 'dod 'jo bas// bsam don yongs su rdzogs pa'i bkra shis shog /ces pa'ang 'phags pa'i nor gyi gter chen po la gdod nas dbang bsgyur ba dpal ldan bla ma 'jam mgon dgyes pa'i dpa' bo'i bka' lung nor bu'i phud du spyi bor bkod de/ gzhan phan gyi blos byams mgon tā'i si tu'i 'bangs tha karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spungs yang khod bha ṭa'i shing gis brgyan pa'i lhan skyes mdzes ma'i khyim dang nye ba'i bsti gnas su grub pa'i gzhung bzang po sor bzhag tu bsgrigs pa dge legs 'phel//
